column1: Meeting,  by  a  majority  of  not  less  than  one  third  of  the
members present and voting, to make rules not inconsistent
with the provisions of this Act or any other written law for all
or any of the following matters:—

column2: the election of the office bearers, their term of office,
resignation from, or vacation of, or removal from
office and their powers, duties and functions;
the election and the terms of office of members of
the Committee of Management other than the office
bearers, and the powers, duties and functions of the
classification of membership and membership fees,
admission, withdrawal and expulsion of members
the administration and management of the property
of the Corporation, the custody of its funds and the
maintenance and audit of its accounts;
the procedure to be followed at any meeting of the
Committee  of  Management  and  the  quorum
therefore and the conduct of business thereat;  and
the  mangement  of  the  affairs  of  the  Corporation
and the accomplishment of its objects.
